body:
Source: GitHub issue #632 (bug, security, P1-high, area:autopilot; class false-green). Re-verified on main @ 5343b84b: packages/fleet/lib/gate-pipeline.mjs:30-31 `try { bytes = readBytes(path); } catch { continue; }` and `if (bytes === undefined || bytes === null) continue;` drop any protected candidate that is absent or unreadable before it reaches scanProtectedPaths. A worker (or a repo-authored fleet.gate command) that deletes or chmods 000 a protected control file (a ticket-store file under .adlc/, or .claude/settings.local.json) therefore leaves scan.ok true and runGatePipeline returns { ok: true, stage: 'passed' }. The tracked-diff scope check cannot catch it because the orchestrator's commit pathspec excludes .claude and .adlc. Secondary: packages/fleet/lib/live-deps.mjs:154-160 parseStatusPaths does `l.slice(3).trim()` on `git status --porcelain --ignored -uall` output, so a C-quoted path ("a\tb") or a rename entry ("old -> new") yields a path that does not exist on disk, which is then dropped the same way.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/fleet`: lib/gate-pipeline.mjs (collectProtectedCandidates, runGatePipeline), lib/protected-paths.mjs (scanProtectedPaths, isUnderProtectedPrefix, isInert, BASE_MANIFEST; already fails closed for a manifest path with no template, and treats bytes !== template as "worker modified", and a non-manifest path as "unexpected file"), lib/live-deps.mjs (production adapter: parseStatusPaths and the wtGit status call near :588, readBytes returning undefined for an absent file). Tests: `npm test -w packages/fleet` from the worktree root. Existing tests in packages/fleet/test/gate-pipeline.test.mjs and live-deps.test.mjs are NOT rails and may change; if one pins the drop behaviour, rewrite it and say so in the PR body.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. collectProtectedCandidates never drops a path that passes the protected-prefix and not-inert filter. A path whose readBytes throws or returns undefined/null becomes a candidate `{ path, bytes: null, unreadable: true }` (a new object; do not mutate inputs).
2. runGatePipeline fails the integrity stage for any unreadable candidate, with a violation reason that says the file is absent or unreadable (e.g. `protected control file is absent or unreadable`), so the operator can tell a deletion from a modification. Implement this in gate-pipeline.mjs (scanProtectedPaths in protected-paths.mjs is railed and stays as is; either pre-filter unreadable candidates into violations and merge them with the scan's, or pass them through, but the reason text for an unreadable file must be the absent/unreadable one). The stage name and output shape stay what the integrity stage already reports for a violation.
3. parseStatusPaths switches to NUL-delimited output: the production call becomes `git status --porcelain=v1 -z --ignored --untracked-files=all`, and parseStatusPaths parses -z records (XY, space, path, NUL; for a rename or copy entry the next NUL-terminated field is the original path, and BOTH paths are returned). Export parseStatusPaths so tests drive the production parser, and test it against the output of a real `git status` in a temp repo containing a path with a tab or quote and a staged rename, not a hand-written string only.
4. Regression guard: a protected file that is present and byte-identical to its template still passes; inert paths still skip; non-protected paths still ignored.
5. Documentation: update `packages/fleet/README.md` and make the SAME edit by hand in `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/fleet.mdx` (hand-maintained mirror; never regenerate). State that an absent or unreadable protected control file fails the integrity stage.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 collectProtectedCandidates returns an unreadable candidate (not drops it) when readBytes throws and when it returns undefined. verify: `node --test packages/fleet/test/protected-absent.test.mjs`
- AC2 runGatePipeline with a deleted protected manifest file (and separately a deleted non-manifest protected file) returns ok: false at the integrity stage with the absent/unreadable reason. verify: `node --test packages/fleet/test/protected-absent.test.mjs`
- AC3 parseStatusPaths, fed real `git status --porcelain=v1 -z --ignored --untracked-files=all` output from a temp repo, returns the literal path for a filename containing a tab and a double quote, and both paths of a staged rename. verify: `node --test packages/fleet/test/protected-absent.test.mjs`
- AC4 Present, unmodified protected files and inert paths still pass. verify: `node --test packages/fleet/test/protected-absent.test.mjs`
- AC5 Existing fleet suite green. verify: `npm test -w packages/fleet`
- AC6 Docs updated in both places. verify: `grep -c "absent or unreadable" packages/fleet/README.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/fleet.mdx` (each >= 1)
- AC7 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally)

OUT OF SCOPE: issues #633 and #634 (other fleet trust-boundary findings), any change to protected-paths.mjs, BASE_MANIFEST contents, or the orchestrator's commit pathspec.
title: fleet: an absent or unreadable protected control file fails the integrity scan instead of being dropped
